title: Higher Education Support Amendment (New Zealand Citizens) Bill 2015
short_title: Higher Education Support Amendment (New Zealand Citizens) Bill 2015

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would extend access to government student loans to certain New Zealand citizens holding special category visas who settled in Australia as dependent children.
Applicants would need longstanding residence, including eight of the preceding ten years in Australia and 18 months of the preceding two years, alongside other eligibility requirements.
The changes would cover higher education and eligible vocational study, applying to units with a census date on or after 1 January 2016.
changes: Residence testing would generally use the first successful assistance request for the same course.
The dependent child definition would require someone under 18 without a spouse or de facto partner.
Additional Commonwealth payments resulting from the bill would require money appropriated by Parliament for that purpose.
summary.affected: New Zealand citizens with special category visas seeking government loans for higher education or eligible vocational study are affected.
